description: Change fields on an existing product. Takes the product ID — get it from get_products, never guess. Only the fields you pass are changed. Prices are HUMAN strings like "24.99". Variant fields (price, sku, barcode): for a product with several variants use `variants` with the ids from get_products; plain `price`/`sku`/`barcode` work only when there is exactly one variant.

barcode.description: New barcode, only for a single-variant product

price.description: New price, only for a single-variant product

productId.description: Product id from get_products — not a name

sku.description: New SKU, only for a single-variant product

variants.description: Per-variant changes; ids and labels come from the variants list in get_products

name: hub_update_product
title: Update product
